{"subject":"Onboarding new Juicebox sellers into a pipeline process","body":"Hi Connor,

Juicebox has three open sales roles, an Account Executive and two Sales Managers, with the latest posted 6 days ago. Headcount is also up 83.7% in six months.

New sellers need a repeatable pipeline process from day one. Quillpath reads your CRM every night, flags stalled deals (no activity, missing next step, slipped close date), and gives each rep a short list of next actions per deal. Setup takes about 15 minutes on your existing CRM, with nothing to migrate.

Would you like to try the free 14-day pilot on your real pipeline?","missing":["Whether Juicebox uses HubSpot or Salesforce (Quillpath connects to both, but the CRM in use is not in the evidence)","Connor's specific responsibilities for pipeline review or rep onboarding in EMEA"]}
